reason: I'm solo and paying out of my own pocket on $72K a year — $30 a month per seat is a recurring subscription for a collaboration tool I have no team to share with, and I already jump to free tiers whenever a tool charges per seat.
objection: $30/seat/month for a solo developer with no team to share sessions or agents with — I'd rather stitch together free tiers than pay for another tool to manage.
would_change_my_mind: A permanent free tier for individuals, or charging only once I add teammates.
